title: Senior Backend Engineer — 1Secure Platform
description:
**About Us**
At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.
  
  
Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.
  
  
****Position Overview****
  
  
We are building a cloud-native SaaS platform composed of Java and Spring Boot services deployed to Kubernetes. The platform uses REST and gRPC APIs, reactive and event-driven communication patterns, and a combination of relational, document, caching, and search technologies. The platform architecture and engineering standards are established; engineers will extend existing services and build new capabilities within those guardrails.
  
  
Candidates must be able to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, trace request, event, and data flows across services, and own changes through implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production support.
  
  
We value practical engineering judgment over a checklist of technologies. Candidates should be able to explain design choices, make sensible trade-offs, and build services that are secure, observable, testable, and supportable in production.
  
  
**This role requires proximity to Pune, India.**
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
  
  

* Build maintainable backend services and APIs using modern Java, Spring Boot, and appropriate Spring modules, following the platform's defined architecture and standards.
* Read and understand existing code across services to grasp feature sets, data flows, and integration points, and build on them effectively.
* Develop reactive, non-blocking services with Spring WebFlux and Project Reactor, with practical judgment about when reactive programming is - and is not - the right choice.
* Implement well-designed REST APIs and, where appropriate, gRPC services, with clear contracts, validation, versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility.
* Build event-driven integrations using Kafka and/or RabbitMQ, applying sound practices for message delivery, idempotency, retries, ordering, and dead-letter handling.
* Model and access data in relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL databases, apply caching effectively with Redis, and use Elasticsearch/OpenSearch for indexing and search workloads.
* Package and deploy services to Kubernetes end-to-end: authoring Helm charts, managing Kubernetes configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets (Hashicorp Vault), health probes, resource requests/limits, HPA), and executing safe rolling deployments.
* Write automated tests, participate in design and code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and continually improve service reliability and performance.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, security, DevOps/SRE, and other engineering teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Java development skills: object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and JVM fundamentals.
* Production experience with Spring Boot; practical knowledge of Spring WebFlux/Project Reactor and reactive programming principles.
* Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases: tracing code paths, understanding existing features and conventions, and making changes that fit the established design.
* Strong API engineering skills: REST/HTTP semantics, API contracts, validation, error handling, pagination, versioning, and OpenAPI documentation.
* Distributed-systems fundamentals: timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, rate limiting, idempotency, caching, and graceful degradation.
* Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ and event-driven/asynchronous communication patterns.
* Solid relational database skills with PostgreSQL or MySQL: schema design, SQL, transactions and isolation, indexing, query optimization, and schema migrations (e.g., Flyway/Liquibase).
* Working knowledge of NoSQL data modeling, querying, indexing, consistency, and performance; Elasticsearch/OpenSearch experience is valuable.
* Experience using Redis (or a comparable distributed cache) for caching, session state, or rate limiting, including cache invalidation and TTL strategies.
* Strong automated-testing practices with JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, Spring Boot Test, and Testcontainers; integration and contract testing expected.
* Application security fundamentals with Spring Security: TLS, JWT, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, authentication vs. authorization, secrets management, and secure API development.
* Hands-on Kubernetes deployment experience, including Helm: writing and maintaining charts, values management across environments, Kubernetes configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets, readiness/liveness/startup probes, resource requests and limits), horizontal scaling, and rollout/rollback strategies.
* Practical scripting with Shell and/or Python for automation, diagnostics, build/deployment tasks, and developer tooling.
* Git, Maven or Gradle, CI/CD pipelines, and production observability through structured logs, metrics, and traces (OpenTelemetry).
* Hands-on experience with production observability tooling — at least one in each category: metrics/dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana), log aggregation (Splunk, ELK/OpenSearch Dashboards, Loki), and APM (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, or Azure Application Insights) — for monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting live services.
* Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, review code constructively, and take ownership of services in production.

****Our Values****
**At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action**

* Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
* Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
* Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
* Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
* Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
* Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
* eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.
  
  
****Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix****

* Competitive Health Benefits
* Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
* Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
* Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
* Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AWS
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer - AWS to design, build, integrate, and support the AWS services that power customer-facing digital experiences across Agilent.com and the connected Agilent ecosystem. This role will work within a product-oriented POD to build serverless AWS ETL services, database services, APIs, product data cache capabilities, and integration patterns that support platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Product Information Management (PIM), Coveo Search, and related digital experience capabilities. The engineer will play a key role in supporting the product data cache in AWS that powers product data services needed by Agilent.com experiences, ensuring product information is reliable, performant, scalable, secure, and available for customer-facing journeys. The engineer will also ensure that data, content, product, search, and customer experience services are reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and optimized for business-critical use cases. Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless architectures, API development, data pipelines, Graph APIs, and graph database capabilities on AWS is essential.
  
  
This role currently follows a hybrid work model. Work arrangements may evolve based on future business needs.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Work within a cross-functional POD to deliver AWS services that support customer-facing experiences across Agilent.com, AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, eCommerce, content discovery, and the connected digital ecosystem.
* Design, build, and support serverless AWS ETL services that extract, transform, enrich, normalize, and deliver product, content, search, and customer experience data to downstream platforms.
* Support and enhance the product data cache in AWS that powers product data services consumed by Agilent.com experiences, enabling fast, reliable, and scalable access to product information across customer-facing journeys.
* Build scalable AWS-based APIs and integration services that connect AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, commerce, analytics, and other digital platforms to support customer journeys and business outcomes.
* Develop event-driven and serverless solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, S3, Glue, DynamoDB, Aurora, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related services.
* Design and maintain data pipelines that support structured and unstructured data movement for product information, content metadata, search ingestion, customer experience personalization, and platform synchronization.
* Build and support database services on AWS, including relational, NoSQL, and graph-oriented data models needed to power digital experience, search, content, and product data use cases.

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing.

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals.

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners.

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations.

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news.

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
FPGA Engineer — Module Firmware & Signal Processing
description:
The Role
  
  
We are rebuilding the firmware for the digital modules at the heart of our imaging system — a large array of identical FPGA-based boards that capture, process and report data in lock-step.
  
  
The work is a clean-room implementation: you build the design from a written protocol specification, and you validate it against a working reference system. This is not a maintenance role and it is not code archaeology — you write the RTL, you write the testbench, and you prove on the bench that the numbers come out right.
  
  
The device has no processor subsystem and no operating system. Everything happens in fabric, with a small soft core for housekeeping. If you enjoy owning a design end to end — from the ADC pins through the DSP chain to the bus frame that leaves the board — this is that job.
  
  
What You Will Build
  
  
Bus
  
  
Serial multipoint bus slave: 72-bit frame, reply shifted by one clock, CRC at line rate. Shared return line across 16 modules, output enabled only when granted.
  
  
Capture
  
  
Parallel ADC capture, 14-bit at 20 MSPS, with the sampling window proven — not assumed.
  
  
Processing
  
  
CIC decimation with a programmable rate, windowing, single-bin DFT. Fixed point throughout, with word growth under control.
  
  
Control
  
  
SPI master driving four devices with different word lengths, clock dividers and chip selects.
  
  
Boot
  
  
Configuration from external flash: two images with fallback, plus firmware update over the bus to 192 modules with integrity checking.
  
  
Verification
  
  
Reference model in Python (NumPy) or MATLAB; the RTL must match it in both amplitude and phase.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of production FPGA development — shipped hardware, not evaluation boards.
* Strong RTL design in Verilog, SystemVerilog or VHDL: finite state machines, synchronous design, parameterised modules, disciplined coding style.
* Intel/Altera Quartus (Prime or II). Deep Xilinx/Vivado experience is welcome, but you must be willing and able to work in the Intel toolchain — and be able to show you have moved between vendors before.
* Timing as a discipline: static timing analysis, SDC constraints, setup and hold, clock-domain crossing, synchronisers, metastability, on-chip PLLs and dividers.
* DSP in fixed point: FIR/IIR filters, decimation and interpolation, CIC, windowing, FFT/DFT, DDS/NCO, quadrature processing, Q format, truncation, rounding, overflow and saturation.
* Board-level interfaces: parallel ADC capture, source-synchronous sampling and phase alignment, LVDS and differential pairs, SPI, I²C, UART, multipoint buses.
* Memory and buses: external SRAM, FIFOs, dual-port memory, buffering, Avalon-MM or AXI-Lite, register maps.
* Verification you write yourself: self-checking testbenches in ModelSim, QuestaSim or Verilator, compared against a Python or MATLAB golden model.
* Bench debugging: SignalTap or ILA, logic analyser, oscilloscope, JTAG, latency measurement, and the patience to chase intermittent behaviour.
* Tooling that survives handover: TCL build scripts, git, reproducible builds, code review.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Soft processor work: Nios II, MicroBlaze or RISC-V — bootloader, configuration flash, JTAG programming.
* Experience implementing a design from a specification where no source code was available, with a reference unit to measure against.
* Portability work: migrating between FPGA families or vendors, replacing IP cores, writing code free of vendor primitives.
* Background in radar, test and measurement, or scientific instrumentation.
* Firmware update and integrity-checking schemes across large numbers of identical nodes.

Not a Fit
  
  
To save everyone’s time, this role is not a match if your experience is:
  
  

* Entirely on microcontrollers rather than FPGA fabric.
* Entirely around a processor subsystem and Linux (Zynq PS, PetaLinux, driver work) — our device has neither.
* Integrating ready-made cores in a graphical block builder, with no RTL of your own.
* Verification only, with no design ownership.
* Academic or evaluation-board projects only.
* A list of technologies with no project you can describe in detail.

Why Join EMTensor
  
  
We are building a team of exceptional engineers to solve some of the hardest problems in signal processing, FPGA design and imaging.
  
  
At EMTensor you work in a small, highly technical team where every engineer has a meaningful impact on the product and on the company. We value technical excellence, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to solve difficult problems.
  
  
If you are passionate about building world-class technology and want to work alongside other top engineers on problems that truly matter, we would love to hear from you.

FPGA Design Engineer
  
  

* RTL Design Engineer
* Firmware Engineer (FPGA)

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. .
  
  
****Job Summary****
Supports the IT function in the implementation, maintenance, support, testing, and continuous improvement of SAP Supply Chain Management solutions, with primary focus on SAP Service Parts Planning (SPP). Works with business partners and IT teams to analyze requirements, troubleshoot application and integration issues, support change requests, and ensure reliable operation of business-critical SCM processes.
  
  
****What You Will Do**
:**

* Supports, maintains, and improves SAP SPP and SCM business processes, including SPP Planning Engine, Demand Capture, DRP and Deployment, SNC, CIF, Global ATP, Segmentation, Stocking/De-Stocking, Manage Demand, Forecasting, EOQ, and Safety Stock.
* Performs root cause analysis of application, process, interface, and integration issues and recommends appropriate solutions.
* Supports and improves existing SAP interfaces, functions, and integrated business processes.
* Performs functional/component testing, manual unit testing, and integration testing to validate solutions against agreed business requirements.
* Supports error analysis and resolution during testing and production support activities.
* Follows established ITSM incident management processes and supports resolution of P2, P3, and P4 incidents.
* Communicates with business partners to understand issues, assess business impact, explain resolutions, and coordinate with relevant support teams.
* Performs end-to-end Change Request Management, including requirement gathering, preparation and review of functional requirement documentation, testing, implementation support, and required controls.
* Ensures adherence to applicable governance and control requirements, including SOX compliance.
* Collaborates with other application and technical teams to ensure successful integration across SAP SCM, ECC, APO, CRM, and EWM landscapes.
* Contributes to the implementation, customization, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Global Template / SCM Core Solution.
* Ensures timely delivery of high-quality solutions and documentation.
* Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with flexibility to support rotational shifts as required.

****Degree Requirement**
:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech), or equivalent relevant experience where applicable.
  
  
**What You Have:**
:
  
  
Core Application Systems
  
  
Knowledge of major production application systems used to support supply chain and service parts planning processes, ability to apply functional knowledge of SAP SCM and SAP SPP in support, maintenance, testing, and implementation activities.
  
  
Working Knowledge
  
  

* Demonstrates functional knowledge of SAP SCM Procurement / Materials Management and related business processes.
* Demonstrates knowledge of SAP SPP, including Planning Engine, Demand Capture, DRP, Deployment, Forecasting, EOQ, Safety Stock, and stocking/de-stocking processes.
* Understands key business functions and services supported by SAP SCM applications.
* Uses functional specifications, process documentation, support procedures, and Global Template documentation to troubleshoot and support applications.
* Applies 3–5 years of relevant SCM/SAP functional experience to application support and improvement activities.

Problem Solving
  
  
Knowledge of approaches, tools, and techniques for recognizing, analyzing, and resolving application, operational, integration, and process problems; ability to apply structured problem-solving techniques to diverse support situations.
  
  
**Working Knowledge:**

* Performs structured root cause analysis for SAP SPP process, application, and interface issues.
* Follows established problem reporting, incident management, and escalation procedures.
* Analyzes P2/P3/P4 incidents and coordinates resolution with appropriate technical, functional, and business teams.
* Evaluates business impact and identifies appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* Demonstrates analytical thinking and applies disciplined troubleshooting techniques to complex application issues.

Application Design, Architecture
  
  
**Knowledge Of SAP Application Design And Functional Solution Principles:**
Ability to translate business requirements and process needs into appropriate functional solutions within the SAP SCM landscape.
  
  
**Working Knowledge:**

* Understands the functional architecture of SAP SPP and SCM solutions and their interaction with related SAP systems.
* Participates in the evaluation and design of changes to existing SAP SCM/SPP functionality.
* Understands dependencies between business processes, application functionality, interfaces, master data, and integration components.
* Contributes to functional solution design while considering performance, reliability, integration, security, and Global Template standards.
* Understands the implications of solution changes across integrated systems and business processes.

**System Testing:**
Knowledge of system and software testing, ability to plan, execute, document, and support functional, unit, and integration testing to ensure quality throughout the application life cycle.
  
  
Working Knowledge
  
  

* Executes assigned functional/component and unit testing against agreed business and functional requirements.
* Performs manual unit and integration testing for new functionality and change requests.
* Documents test results, defects, issues, and supporting evidence in accordance with established processes.
* Supports analysis and resolution of errors identified during testing.
* Validates fixes and application changes before implementation into production environments.
* Coordinates with functional, technical, integration, and business teams to ensure end-to-end solution quality.
* Communication and Collaboration

**Support:**
Ability to communicate effectively with business partners, application teams, technical teams, and other stakeholders to support effective delivery and resolution of SAP SCM/SPP requirements and issues.
  
  
**Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates effectively with business partners to understand application issues and requirements.
* Clearly explains issue impact, root cause, proposed resolution, and implementation considerations.
* Collaborates with other functional and technical teams to resolve cross-application and integration issues.
* Produces clear functional, testing, change, and support documentation.
* Demonstrates strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and cross-team communication skills.

****Required Qualifications And Experience****

* 3–5 years of relevant experience with strong functional knowledge of SCM Procurement or Materials Management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech).
* Experience working with SAP SPP and relevant planning and supply-chain processes.
* Experience in implementation, customization, or maintenance of a Global Template / SCM Core Solution.
* Knowledge of integration between SCM and other SAP components.
* Experience with integrated ECC, APO, CRM, and EWM landscapes is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Tidal or similar job-scheduling tools is an added advantage.
* Knowledge or experience related to S/4HANA conversions is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability and flexibility to work in rotational shifts.

title: Senior Data Scientist (R14369)
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
  
  
Location Note
  
  
We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position,
**the role must be performed from within India.**
The Opportunity
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support our Marketing Data Science team and accelerate new member growth through predictive modeling and advanced analytics. You'll build prospect targeting and conversion prediction models that help Oportun identify promising prospective members, improve acquisition conversion rates, and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). You'll own models end to end—from feature development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—in partnership with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Your day-to-day**

* You'll develop and deploy machine learning models for prospect targeting and conversion prediction to increase new member acquisition.
* You'll analyze internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing campaign and engagement data, third-party consumer and alternative data, and credit bureau data to build predictive features and identify growth opportunities.
* You'll apply statistical and machine learning methods, including logistic regression, gradient boosting, and related techniques, to improve targeting accuracy and conversion rates.
* You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring.
* You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows.
* You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability.

Who You Are
  
  
**The right fit looks like this**

* You're a curious, rigorous data scientist who turns complex data into reliable models and practical business decisions.
* You enjoy ambiguous growth problems, take ownership of outcomes, and balance predictive performance with measurable acquisition impact.
* You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward.
* You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring
  
  
**Required**
**Skills & experience**

* 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, or a related field.
* Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets.
* Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems.
* Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production machine learning models.
* Experience building reusable data preparation, feature engineering, and model scoring pipelines.
* Ability to assess model performance, data quality, and business outcomes and communicate clear recommendations.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and project ownership skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, prospect targeting, or conversion propensity modeling.
* Experience with internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing engagement data, third-party consumer or alternative data, or credit bureau data.
* Experience with AWS, SageMaker, EMR, Spark SQL, Hive, or similar cloud and large-scale data technologies.
* Experience in consumer lending, fintech, credit risk, or fraud risk.
* Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve modeling, coding, documentation, or research workflows.

Our AI Mindset
  
  
**We build with AI. We lead with judgment.**
AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.
  
  
We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be
**open to experimenting**
, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.
  
  
In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter.
**We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.**

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.
